conclusion: Retrospective candidate only. No account sizing or combined filters without evidence of stability.
limitations: Feature choice follows inspection of2026 outcomes; frozen pre2025 cut alone does not make2026 fresh validation.
Original universe/data and costs retained; Binance candles with OKX Lv1 fee benchmark read2026-10-23.
Instantaneous5m-close fills, no funding or capacity model; separate10bp-per-market-fill slippage stress.
Independent original-riskR, not account returns; source/gap-censored trades retained separately.
Period tables require each signal/control own entry and exit inside the period; boundary-crossing exclusions separately counted. Monthly sums are not additive.
Bootstrap/signflip intervals are conditional descriptive statistics; feature search, survivorship, and shared market exposure limit inference.
Removing winning trades or weeks is an outcome-conditioned fragility test; not a causal strategy filter.
